result.description:
Lead enterprise platform strategy, governance and optimisation in a major digital transformation program.   Your new company     Join a large and complex organisation undertaking a significant digital transformation journey. With a strong focus on innovation, service excellence, and continuous improvement, the organisation is investing heavily in modern enterprise platforms and digital capabilities to enhance operational performance and customer outcomes.  This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the future direction of key enterprise technology platforms while partnering with senior stakeholders across the business to drive strategic outcomes.    Your new role     As the Business Technology Platform Owner, you will be responsible for the strategic governance, operational management, and ongoing optimisation of enterprise technology platforms. Acting as the key business representative and platform SME, you will ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value while maintaining compliance, security, and operational excellence.  You will own the end-to-end platform lifecycle, developing roadmaps, managing enhancements, driving adoption, and working closely with business, technology, architecture, security, and vendor partners to support organisational objectives.  Key responsibilities include:   
 
 Owning platform strategy, governance, performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.   
 Developing and maintaining platform roadmaps aligned to business priorities and transformation goals.   
 Leading the identification, prioritisation, and delivery of platform enhancements and new capabilities.   
 Managing platform performance, service levels, availability, and user adoption.   
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet business and operational requirements.   
 Monitoring risks, compliance obligations, cybersecurity requirements, and platform dependencies.   
 Supporting organisational change, adoption, and optimisation activities.   
 Preparing executive reporting, insights, and performance metrics to support decision-making.   
 Managing vendor relationships and ensuring value is realised from technology investments.   
 
  What you'll need to succeed     To be successful in this role, you will bring experience managing or owning enterprise technology platforms within large and complex environments.  You will have:   
 
 5+ years' experience in a Platform Owner, Platform Manager, Product Owner, Applications Manager, Business Systems Manager, or similar role. 
 Experience with enterprise platforms such as SAP BTP, SAP Enterprise Service Management, Salesforce, Microsoft Power Platform, Oracle Cloud, or comparable technologies. 
 Strong understanding of technology governance, platform lifecycle management, and strategic roadmap development. 
 Demonstrated experience driving platform optimisation, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and business stakeholders. 
 Knowledge of risk management, compliance, cybersecurity, and service management practices. 
 Experience supporting digital transformation, business improvement, and technology-enabled change programs. 
 Strong business analysis and requirements management capability. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to own and shape the future direction of critical enterprise platforms.   
 Exposure to large-scale digital transformation and business improvement initiatives.   
 A highly collaborative environment with significant stakeholder engagement.   
 The chance to influence strategic technology decisions that deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.   
 Competitive remuneration package and long-term career development opportunities.   
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description: CP RENOVATION AND CONSTRUCTION PTY LTD  About the Role  This full-time position offers an excellent opportunity for an experienced Wall and Floor Tiler to work on a variety of residential renovation and construction projects. The successful applicant will be responsible for delivering high-quality tiling work while ensuring compliance with Australian building standards, workplace safety requirements, and project specifications.  Key Responsibilities   Examine plans, drawings and project specifications to determine tiling layouts, material quantities and installation requirements.  Measure, mark and prepare wall and floor surfaces for tiling by cleaning, levelling and applying waterproofing membranes where required.  Cut, shape and finish ceramic, porcelain, stone, mosaic and other tiling materials using specialised hand and power tools.  Lay wall and floor tiles in accordance with design specifications to achieve accurate alignment, spacing and pattern consistency.  Mix, apply and spread adhesives, mortar and grout to ensure secure installation and long-lasting finishes.  Install decorative borders, feature tiles and custom patterns where specified by clients or project plans.  Remove damaged or defective tiles and carry out repairs or replacement work while maintaining existing finishes.  Check completed work to ensure quality standards, level surfaces and compliance with Australian construction requirements.  Interpret technical drawings and coordinate with supervisors and other construction trades to ensure efficient project delivery.  Maintain tools, equipment and a clean, safe work environment in accordance with workplace health and safety regulations.   Skills & Experience   Relevant trade qualification equivalent to  Certificate III in Wall and Floor Tiling  or overseas equivalent.  Minimum of  2 years' relevant post-qualification experience  (or at least 3 years' relevant experience where no formal qualification is held).  Demonstrated experience installing ceramic, porcelain, stone and other wall and floor tiling products.  Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical specifications.  Strong attention to detail with a commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship.  Sound knowledge of waterproofing systems, adhesives, grouts and Australian tiling practices.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a construction team.  Strong problem-solving, communication and time-management skills.  Commitment to workplace health and safety standards.  Current driver's licence will be advantageous.   What We Offer   Full-time permanent position.  Annual salary of  $80,000 plus Superannuation .  Opportunity to work on diverse residential renovation and construction projects.  Supportive team environment with ongoing professional development.  Stable employment with a growing and reputable construction business committed to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction.     Apply now  if you are a skilled Wall and Floor Tiler looking to build your career with a company that values craftsmanship, professionalism, and excellence in construction.  About Company    CP Construction is a growing Australian construction and renovation company specialising in high-quality residential renovations, building improvements, and expert trade services. We are committed to delivering exceptional workmanship, premium finishes, and outstanding customer satisfaction across a wide range of renovation and construction projects. As our business continues to expand, we are seeking a skilled and motivated  Wall and Floor Tiler  to join our professional team. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality carpentry and construction work across a range of residential and commercial projects. Working closely with the project team, you will interpret plans, construct and install building frameworks and fixtures, and ensure all work is completed to the highest standards of workmanship, safety, and compliance. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to the successful delivery of projects while building your career with a company that values quality, professionalism, and teamwork.   Benefits   Full-time, stable employment with a growth opportunity   Variety of high-quality residential & commercial renovation and home extension projects across Sydney  Supportive, professional team environment with a strong focus on safety and workmanship excellence  Opportunity to work alongside experienced designers, project managers and licensed tradespeople    Task & responsibilities   Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and specifications to determine project requirements.  Construct, erect, install, and repair structures and fixtures made from wood and other materials.  Measure, cut, and shape wood, plastic, and other materials.  Assemble and fasten materials to make frameworks or props using hand tools and power tools.  Inspect and replace damaged framework or other structures and fixtures.  Ensure projects are completed according to building codes and safety standards.  Work collaboratively with other team members and contractors.  Maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Adhere to all company policies and procedures.  Contribute to a positive team culture by providing mentorship and guidance to junior carpenters.    Qualification & experience   Minimum AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV or Higher in carpentry or in a relevant field     Minimum 1 year full time or equivalent work experience in related field   Demonstrated ability to read and interpret technical documents, drawings, plans and specifications  Strong working knowledge of timber framing, joinery, cladding and finishing techniques applicable to residential & commercial renovations and extensions  Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality workmanship  Current driver's licence (desirable)  Excellent communication   About Company     RPR Carpentry & Building Pty Ltd is a trusted construction company specialising in high-quality residential and commercial carpentry and building services. We are committed to delivering exceptional workmanship, reliable service, and outstanding results on every project. With a strong focus on quality, safety, and customer satisfaction, we take pride in our skilled team and collaborative work environment. As our business continues to grow, we are looking for dedicated and motivated professionals who share our passion for craftsmanship and excellence to join our team.
